gen-dafont-plakkaat-sora: Heavy bent-straw letters, their terminals curling nearly back to the stem. Plakkaat does its best work shouting in dense, heavy shapes, while Sora, a precise geometric sans, simply speaks, with curves that turn without any swell.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-amulya: Amulya keeps its curves generous and modern beneath Quantum, whose loose, wire-bent letters float with plenty of breathing space. Whole paragraphs in it would run smooth and quite unhurried.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-almendra: Dignified and bookish, Almendra has a deep midsection in its lowercase that gives text a settled look. And Quantum, plain and unmodulated up top, leaves the reading feel to Almendra, which settles into a warm, steady rhythm.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-quando: Quando reads traditional and bookish, its sparse, wide spacing and tall middle zone giving every word room. Quantum, with no stroke contrast at all, works alongside it as a clean, tech-minded header.
gen-dafont-quantum-space-grotesk: Loose, tech-clean lettering from Quantum, with mouths left open and ascenders cut short. Space Grotesk then reads steadily, its ribbon-like strokes and hollow-reed counters keeping text easy to follow line after line.
gen-dafont-redux-fs-amulya: Wide-spaced and geometric, Redux greets every curve with a visible entry stroke, while Amulya, a sans-serif, keeps its curve gaps generous. Both stay open and modern, nothing cramped anywhere.
gen-dafont-redux-fs-synonym: Redux spaces its letters wide and gives each curve a big, visible entrance, with a gentle ebb and flow of weight. Synonym supplies a plain stripe of constant ink, the pair's steadiest quality.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-almendra: Almendra brings dignified weight, its deep lowercase midsection giving text a settled look. Almendra feels bookish beside Redux, whose widely spaced, geometric letters taper gently and look cleanly modern.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-almendra: Starborn is dreamy and ethereal, with huge gaps between letters. Almendra, a dignified serif with a deep lowercase midsection, grounds it with bookish weight so the two feel like mist over stone.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-bree-serif: Starborn is all dreamy drift, its letters spread far apart. It earns its keep big and brief, while Bree Serif, literary and refined with outsized lowercase, carries the rest.
